SubTitle: Step-by-step WSL2 installer, Distro selector, and deep uninstaller
LblGuideAuto:
Auto Install will automatically run:
• Enable Virtual Machine Platform & WSL
• Update WSL2 kernel to latest
• Set WSL2 as default version
• Download and install the selected Distro
Step1Hint: Enable Windows virtual machine platform (required for WSL2).
Step2Title: Step 2: Enable Windows Subsystem for Linux
Step2Hint: Enable the core WSL Windows optional feature.
Step3Title: Step 3: Update WSL2 Kernel & Set Default 2
Step3Hint: Update the WSL kernel and set WSL 2 as default.
Step4Hint: Download and install the Linux distro chosen on the left.
LblBiosNote: Note: If Virtualization errors occur, enable Intel VT-x / AMD-V in UEFI/BIOS.
LblWarnRemove: WARNING: Removing WSL completely will unregister all Linux distros (deleting VHDX data), disable Windows features, uninstall MSI/Appx packages, delete C:\Program Files\WSL, and remove the Linux icon from File Explorer.
BtnRestartExplorer: Refresh Explorer & Start Search (Clear icon cache)
ChkRemoveAppxMsi: 3. Remove Store/Appx & MSI (WSL / Ubuntu) + winget uninstall
ChkCleanRegistryIcon: 5. Remove Linux icon (CLSID) from File Explorer & Shortcuts
LblCustomHint: Tip: To reset a distro while keeping WSL2, only check item 1.
